green_ratio.overlap_note: Two formal ratios share a common green-spine numerator of 1,650,353 sqm: the linear-park segments of public_space (PUBLIC-001..007) coincide in coordinates and declared area with the green-space garden-ridge segments (GREEN-001/003/004/006/008/009/011). The union of green-space and public-space area is approx. 3,213,681 sqm (net ratio approx. 0.281), not the sum of the two ratios; hard civic-plaza net ratio is 0.81%.

public_space_ratio.overlap_note: Two formal ratios share a common green-spine numerator of 1,650,353 sqm (94.5% of this ratio's numerator). Union with green-space is approx. 3,213,681 sqm (net ratio approx. 0.281); hard civic-plaza net ratio is 0.81%.
